---
name: speckit-clarify
description: Resolve genuine ambiguities in the existing active workshop specification using the binding contract and participant answers; do not create a feature or implement it.
---

# Workshop clarification

Read `.specify\README.md` and validate the same active feature and all its
required state. Read its `spec.md`, requirements checklist, the constitution
and `workshops\acceptance.md`. Identify consequential ambiguity or conflict;
do not expand scope or ask questions already settled by the contract.

Resolve only questions supported by those sources or explicit participant
answers. If a necessary answer is unavailable, state the question and stop;
never invent it. Revise the existing `spec.md` in place and record the
clarification and source there. Inspect the checklist and uncheck items whose
prior review is invalidated; leave the participant to review them again. Do not
change active state, create another feature, produce plans or tasks, or edit
application code. Report exact changed paths and unresolved issues. Request a
fresh human specification and checklist review before planning.
